judgment.most_surprising_gap: The 26 WDL tasks are not the proposed 28 atomic catalog tools; most software boundaries are embedded in composite tasks.
judgment.subcommand_model: Prefer one node per materializable biological stage plus an operation profile; do not create a node for every CLI subcommand without a declared boundary.
additional_gaps: RSEM gene and isoform outputs are collapsed in the current catalog.
STAR clean_fastq_read actually represents rRNA-depleted/unmapped reads.
MultiQC needs named producer fan-in plus an at-least-one constraint.
decide_before_decomposition: Canonical slot names and WDL-local binding rules.
